_comment: How the readers of method/1 (cli/lib/framework/method.js, arena/mt_eval_harness/framework/method.py) read a method.json written before it — DATA, so the two runtimes cannot map an old document differently. Two old shapes: the CLI plugin manifest (it has `type`, one of cli_types) and the harness plugin manifest (it has `entry_point`). `kind_requires` is the one setting each method/1 kind must name: an error in a method/1 document, a warning in an old one (old documents must keep working). Held to shared/test-fixtures/framework/method-vectors.json in both runtimes.
